Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 29
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the historical stock data presented on the Yahoo Finance page. Despite the page displaying a table with columns for "Date", "Open", "High", "Low", "Close", and "Adj Close", the agent scrolled through the data (which was filtered to show recent dates like Dec 2024, Nov 2024, etc.) and did not identify that the "Close" column represented the unadjusted price. The agent continued to scroll and search for the year 2007 without realizing that the data shown was already filtered to a recent time range (2024-2025) and that the "Close" prices in the visible table (e.g., 244.48, 250.42) were the unadjusted prices for those recent dates. The agent failed to change the date filter to the 2000-2010 range as instructed in Step 28, instead inputting the end date but the resulting table still showed recent data, indicating a failure to properly apply the filter or interpret the resulting view. The agent then concluded the answer was 2007 based on external knowledge or a misinterpretation of the data, rather than finding the specific data point in the table that showed the stock crossing $50 in that year. The agent did not successfully navigate to the historical data for the early 2000s where the unadjusted price would have been visible.
